youtube.description:
This is where your poop actually ends up 😳

When you flush, it rides the sewer to a treatment plant. Giant rakes pull out everything that shouldn't be there (wipes, toys, even phones), then the poop sinks to the bottom of a huge tank as thick brown sludge. The sludge is pumped into giant egg-shaped tanks called digesters, where bacteria eat it for weeks and make gas that helps power the plant.

What's left is dried into 'biosolids', and in many places it's spread on farm fields as fertilizer. So your poop might be helping grow your food 🌽
